supporting_observations.claim: At 13:50:21 UTC, WS-JFROST-01 had a 13.46-second TCP connection to the proxy with 51,000,494 bytes sent by the client and 8,985 bytes received. This supports a large transfer from the workstation to the proxy, but does not identify the external destination or establish that the data reached it.

The available large-transfer record is timestamped about four minutes after the alert's approximate 13:46 UTC time; the provided evidence does not establish whether this difference reflects alert timing or a separate transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: The large-transfer record identifies the workstation-to-proxy connection, but the provided evidence contains no matching proxy request record identifying the destination or request details at that time (T159-00204).
The large-transfer record does not identify the originating process, user action, transferred files, or whether the proxy forwarded the data externally (T159-00204).
claims_not_established: The destination or service receiving the data.
Whether the bytes were forwarded beyond the proxy.
Which process initiated the transfer and whether it was authorized.
What data was transferred or whether it contained sensitive information.
Whether the transfer at 13:50:21 UTC is the activity described in the alert as occurring around 13:46 UTC.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy access/request and tunnel logs for WS-JFROST-01 around 13:46–13:51 UTC, including destination, URL or CONNECT host, and forwarding status.
Endpoint process-to-network telemetry for the 51 MB connection, plus relevant application and browser logs.
File access, staging, and upload records that could identify the transferred content and user action.
Firewall, NAT, or egress records to confirm whether the proxy sent the data to an external destination.
unrelated_findings: Google Drive File Stream started on WS-JFROST-01 at 13:22 UTC (T159-00011, T159-00013). The inventory does not list Google Drive as an approved cloud-storage service. The available records do not link this process to the large transfer, so handle it separately and do not use it to decide this alert.
